title: Preserve a valid guest observation when bridge requests remain pending
description: Host-session prerequisite of97341ad5. Own scripts/local-runner/guest-session.mjs and scripts/tests/local-runner-bridge.test.mjs. Today child close exit0 becomes SESSION_PROTOCOL_VIOLATION solely because session.pending.length>0, even after valid hello/observation/clean EOF; stop already aborts forwards and closes stdin. Make authenticated supervisor terminal observation+clean EOF+exit0 finalize once while cancelling/abandoning unresolved agent requests; never replay a request, dispatch queued work after terminal completion, or write late replies to closed stdin. Preserve real provider/protocol/timeout/abort failures and every malformed/duplicate/trailing-frame guard; cancellation cannot erase a prior failure or claim an upstream side effect was undone. Test pending active and queued forwards at successful finish, late resolve/reject/abort races, no extra forward/reply/onObservation, and negative no-observation/nonzero/partial/trailing-frame cases. Use existing stop/controller/timer ownership, no second session queue. Do not modify GUARD/pump or certification. Full external snapshot gate: node --test scripts/tests/local-runner*.test.mjs && (cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test). Depend on containment and provider-resolution task for explicit source serialization; parent follows this test file.
definitionOfDone: Valid hello/one observation/clean EOF/exit0 succeeds once despite unresolved agent requests; pending work is cancelled without late forwarding/writes.
Malformed framing, missing observation, nonzero exit, real timeout/abort and pre-existing failures remain failures in race-focused tests.
No leaked timers/listeners or repeated side effects; full runner+daemon regression passes in an external snapshot.
